identificationModule.briefTitle: To Evaluate a Phase I/II Clinical Study of XNW5004 Tablets in Patients With Relapsed/Refractory Advanced Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase I/II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Initial Efficacy of XNW5004 Tablets in Patients With Relapsed/Refractory Advanced Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Patients with advanced tumors diagnosed histologically or cytologically at the study center who were refractory to standard therapy or had relapsed received XNW5004 tablets

armGroups.label: XNW5004
armGroups.description: Phase 1：treated with escalated doses of XNW5004 respectively； Phase 2：treated with RP2D of XNW5004 respectively

interventions.name: XNW5004 tablets
interventions.description: XNW5004 an EZH2 inhibitor, BID, administered in continuous

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of treatment-emergent adverse events (AEs)[Safety and Tolerability]
primaryOutcomes.description: The incidence and severity of treatment-emergent AEs will be collected and the safety and tolerability of XNW5004 will be assessed.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of about 10 months

primaryOutcomes.description: Recommended phase 2 dose (RP2D) will be established according to the incidence of dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs) of escalated doses of XNW5004.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 28 days since the date of first dose in phase 1

secondaryOutcomes.description: Pharmacokinetics profile of a single dose and continuous medication of XNW5004 and its metabolite (plasma): Time to peak (Tmax) of plasma concentration
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 28 days since the date of first dose

secondaryOutcomes.description: Pharmacokinetics profile of a single dose and continuous medication of XNW5004 and its metabolite (plasma): Maximum plasma concentration (Cmax)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 28 days since the date of first dose

secondaryOutcomes.description: Pharmacokinetics profile of a single dose and continuous medication of XNW5004 and its metabolite (plasma): Halflife (T1/2)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 28 days since the date of first dose

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the response rate of subjects to the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 8 weeks through study completion, an average of about 10 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the progression-free survival of the subjects after the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 8 weeks through study completion, an average of about 10 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the duration of Response of the subjects after the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 8 weeks through study completion, an average of about 10 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the Complete response rate of the subjects after the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 8 weeks through study completion, an average of about 10 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the partial response rate of the subjects after the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 8 weeks through study completion, an average of about 10 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the disease control rate of the subjects after the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 8 weeks through study completion, an average of about 10 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The correlation between potential biomarkers (including but not limited to EZH2 mutations, etc.) and therapeutic efficacy
secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the correlation between potential biomarkers (including but not limited to EZH2 mutations, etc.) and therapeutic efficacy of the subjects after the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 8 weeks through study completion, an average of about 10 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: H3K27me3 (H3 histone 27th lysine trimethylation)/H3 histone relative baseline change level
secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess the H3K27me3 (H3 histone 27th lysine trimethylation)/H3 histone relative baseline change level of the subjects after the treatment of XNW5004
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 28 days since the date of first dose
